messages.subject: How is resource utilization calculated?
parts:
This question is regarding: 

resources <- get_mon_resources(envs)
plot(resources, metric = "utilization")


Is "utilization" the sum of all activity time divided by simulation duration?

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] How is resource utilization calculated?
parts:
2018-05-01 11:01 GMT+02:00 Cwei <slende...@gmail.com>:
> This question is regarding:
>
> resources <- get_mon_resources(envs)
> plot(resources, metric = "utilization")
>
>
> Is "utilization" the sum of all activity time divided by simulation
> duration?

No, it's not. It's the median occupancy ratio (no. of active servers
divided by total capacity). You can check it by yourself:

https://github.com/r-simmer/simmer.plot/blob/master/R/plot.resources.R#L66

Iñaki
